commanders.name: Fire Lord Azula
commanders.blurb: Grixis aggro: Azula makes mana on attack and copies every spell you cast during combat.

commanders.name: Cloud, Ex-SOLDIER
commanders.blurb: Naya equipment: Cloud equips on entry, draws for each equipped creature and makes Treasures.

commanders.name: Ureni of the Unwritten
commanders.blurb: Temur Dragons: whenever Ureni enters or attacks, put a Dragon from the top eight cards onto the battlefield.

commanders.name: Karolina Dean, Runaway
commanders.blurb: Five-color activated abilities: turn the five bonus mana into artifact engines, repeatable abilities and casting beyond your hand.

commanders.name: Pantlaza, Sun-Favored
commanders.blurb: Naya Dinosaurs: each Dinosaur that enters discovers a free spell based on its toughness.

commanders.name: Jace, Multiverse Architect
commanders.blurb: Four-color planeswalker: Jace draws cards, protects himself from attacks and transforms creatures with Polymorph.

commanders.name: The Wise Mothman
commanders.blurb: Sultai radiation: everyone gets rad counters; each milled nonland card adds +1/+1 counters.

commanders.name: Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu
commanders.blurb: Bonus commander: activate creature abilities immediately as though they had haste; Shang-Chi makes two mana for creature abilities.

commanders.name: Teysa Karlov
commanders.blurb: Aristocrats: sacrifice expendable creatures, double death triggers, drain life and rebuild your board.

commanders.name: Breya, Etherium Shaper
commanders.blurb: Artifact engine: build Thopters, recycle artifacts and turn expendable machines into damage and control. No Voltron plan.

commanders.name: Eriette of the Charmed Apple
commanders.blurb: Aura control: charm opposing creatures so they cannot attack you; each Aura fuels your end-step life drain.

commanders.name: Aragorn, the Uniter
commanders.blurb: Four colours, four triggers: white spells raise Human Soldiers, blue spells scry, red spells burn the opponent for 3 and green spells pump +4/+4 - so every gold spell fires several at once.

commanders.name: Atraxa, Praetors' Voice
commanders.blurb: Proliferate every end step to grow +1/+1 counters, planeswalker loyalty and poison until the opponent buckles under ever-growing counters.

commanders.name: Hearthhull, the Worldseed
commanders.blurb: Jund lands-sacrifice: station the Worldseed with big creatures, sacrifice fetches and lands to draw two and replay them from the graveyard, then fly in while every sacrificed land drains the opponent for 2.

commanders.name: Kaalia of the Vast
commanders.blurb: Mardu cheat-into-play: swing with Kaalia and drop Angels, Demons and Dragons from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking, so their enter triggers wreck the board before the opponent can answer.

commanders.name: Lathril, Blade of the Elves
commanders.blurb: Elf tribal: flood the board with Elves and Elf Warrior tokens, drain the opponent and tap ten Elves to finish with a 10-point life swing.

commanders.name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
commanders.blurb: Sultai graveyard value: mill yourself, then replay a land and recast a creature, artifact, enchantment and planeswalker from your graveyard every single turn.

commanders.name: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER
commanders.blurb: Mono-black aristocrats: Sephiroth sacrifices your fodder to draw cards, drains for every creature that dies and becomes the One-Winged Angel after the fourth death in a turn.
